idea-plugin.name: Prompt Templates
idea-plugin.description:
Create, manage and render reusable typed Markdown prompt templates inside JetBrains IDEs.

Templates remain ordinary Markdown files; typed variable metadata is stored separately.

  • Organise, search and edit a nested personal prompt library.
  • Resolve editor selection, current-file, project and clipboard context.
  • Preview exact rendered output before copying or inserting it.
  • Import, export, recover and diagnose templates.

The plugin makes no network requests, executes no prompts and sends no telemetry.

Compatible with standalone JetBrains IDEs based on IntelliJ Platform, with a minimum platform build of 262 (2026.2).

Automated Plugin Verifier coverage currently includes RustRover 2026.2 and WebStorm 2026.2.

Documentation · Support · Privacy

idea-plugin.change-notes:
Nested prompt-library organisation.

  • Create and manage nested organiser folders without changing the portable template format.
  • Move and reorder folders and templates with drag-and-drop, keyboard actions and context menus.
  • Search folder paths, restore tree state and detect external hierarchy changes.
  • Confirm recursive folder deletion against a fresh content fingerprint.
